subtopics.title: 52nd G7 Summit 2026
subtopics.summary: The 52nd G7 Summit was held in Evian-les-Bains, France, under France's presidency, with the theme 'Forging New Partnerships and Rebuilding International Solidarity'. PM Modi participated in the Outreach Session, which marked India's 8th consecutive participation in the G7 Outreach Process. The rotating presidency is due to pass to the United States in 2027.

subtopics.title: Pillars of G7 Influence
subtopics.summary: The booklet describes the G7's influence through several pillars, including shaping financial regulation, responding to crises, and coordinating on energy and geopolitical issues. The forum is also presented as a symbol of cooperation among major economies and as a catalyst for climate and humanitarian commitments. Its dialogue is described as a way to find common ground on complex global challenges.
